criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.what_to_inspect: Solution design, capacity, interoperability, performance evidence, and fit to the stated requirements.

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.what_to_inspect: Named owners, milestones, delivery timeline, staffing, dependencies, testing, training, and risk controls.

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.what_to_inspect: Total cost of ownership, price structure, included services, exclusions, assumptions, and additional fees.

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.what_to_inspect: Security controls, independent audit evidence, privacy practices, incident response, and stated limitations.

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.what_to_inspect: Support hours, response and resolution targets, escalation, comparable delivery experience, and references.

criteria.name: Regulatory Compliance
criteria.what_to_inspect: Regulatory scope, control mapping, examination support.

criteria.name: Auditability & Evidence
criteria.description: Completeness and accessibility of audit trails.
criteria.what_to_inspect: Immutable logs, retention, export, auditor access.

criteria.name: Model Risk Management
criteria.description: Governance for models and automated decisions.

criteria.name: Third-party Risk
criteria.what_to_inspect: Subcontractors, due diligence, notification, exit rights.
